sample_unit: cancer symptoms (NCCN guideline sections compared with ChatGPT responses)

links.outcome: Agreement between ChatGPT symptom management recommendations and NCCN guidelines
links.effect: Mean percent agreement between NCCN and ChatGPT was 37.3% (range 16.7%-81.8%); NCCN gave more specific medication recommendations; ChatGPT recommended medications for constipation and diarrhea not recommended by NCCN.
links.quote: The mean percent agreement between NCCN and ChatGPT recommendations was 37.3% (range 16.7%-81.8%).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's cancer symptom management recommendations against NCCN clinical guidelines and assesses readability, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
